description: Change caption size, position or style using supported values from the project. Size and position work on every caption style; a font change is refused on styles that draw their own type (the change is not partly saved). For spelling or caption text use fix_captions. Read get_project_context first. Saves a new version at once (restore_version undoes it); a change it cannot make is refused and nothing changes. Uses the direct-edit allowance. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: From get_project_context; the live version when left out.

captions.description: Any of size, position and style, with values get_project_context lists.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

output_id.description: A hook, Short or shape from check_video; the main video when left out.

name: set_caption_style

outputSchema.description: Clypmint set_caption_style result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.
